nodes.name: Decide what this run needs
nodes.description: From saved state: is the identity fresh, where to start reading news (checkpoint minus 14 days), is the directory recipe healthy, and which companies are already known.

currentScriptVersion.code:
import json, uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

def _d(s):
    try: return datetime.fromisoformat(str(s)[:19].replace('Z', '')).date()
    except (ValueError, TypeError): return None

def handler(context):
    g = context.get_input
    raw = g('state')
    st = raw.get('result', raw) if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    if not isinstance(st, dict) or 'firm_known' not in st: st = {}
    ok_state = bool(st)
    today = date.today()
    months = int(g('lookback_months') or 12)
    window_start = today - timedelta(days=round(months * 30.44))
    ident = st.get('identity') or {}
    checked = _d(ident.get('identity_checked_at'))
    sources = st.get('sources') or []
    news = [s for s in sources if s.get('source_type') in ('news', 'blog', 'press', 'portfolio_news', 'cohort', 'feed') and s.get('status') != 'retired']
    any_news_broken = any(s.get('status') == 'broken' for s in news)
    identity_fresh = bool(checked and (today - checked).days <= 90 and ident.get('identity_confidence') in ('High', 'Medium') and not any_news_broken)
    news_ok = [s for s in news if s.get('status') != 'broken']
    cps = [_d(s.get('checkpoint_date')) for s in news_ok if s.get('checkpoint_date')]
    news_since = max(window_start, (min(cps) - timedelta(days=14))) if cps else window_start
    # A saved recipe marks a directory even when the URL was first stored under another type (e.g. as a news page).
    dirs = [s for s in sources if (s.get('source_type') == 'portfolio_directory' or s.get('method')) and s.get('status') in ('verified', 'candidate')]
    dirs.sort(key=lambda s: (s.get('status') == 'verified', s.get('updated_at') or ''), reverse=True)
    rec = dirs[0] if dirs else {}
    recipe_ok = bool(rec.get('method') and rec.get('method') != 'agent_only' and rec.get('list_url') and int(rec.get('consecutive_failures') or 0) == 0)
    known = []
    for k in st.get('known_companies') or []:
        known.append({f: ('' if k.get(f) is None else str(k.get(f))) for f in
                      ('name', 'domain', 'verification_status', 'verified_at', 'backing', 'relationship', 'backing_source_url', 'latest_round_type',
                       'latest_round_date', 'latest_round_amount_usd', 'latest_round_leads', 'latest_round_source_url', 'firm_in_latest_round', 'signal_key')})
    return {
        'run_id': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'state_loaded': ok_state, 'first_run': not known,
        'identity_fresh': identity_fresh,
        'cached_identity': {f: ('' if ident.get(f) is None else (' | '.join(ident.get(f)) if isinstance(ident.get(f), list) else str(ident.get(f))))
                            for f in ('official_name', 'firm_domain', 'firm_type', 'aliases', 'alias_collisions', 'crunchbase_url', 'linkedin_url', 'x_url', 'portfolio_url', 'identity_confidence')},
        'cached_news_urls': ' | '.join(s.get('url') for s in news_ok if s.get('url')),
        'news_since': news_since.isoformat(), 'window_start': window_start.isoformat(),
        'recipe_ok': recipe_ok,
        'recipe': {f: ('' if rec.get(f) is None else str(rec.get(f))) for f in ('url', 'method', 'list_url', 'link_pattern', 'profile_pattern', 'expected_count', 'last_count', 'checkpoint_date', 'recipe_version')}
                  | {'needs_js': bool(rec.get('needs_js'))},
        'known_companies': known, 'known_count': len(known), 'today': today.isoformat(),
        'known_profile_urls': [u for u in (st.get('known_profile_urls') or []) if isinstance(u, str)][:20000],
    }

claygentSnapshot.userPrompt:
You resolve the identity of one venture investor or startup accelerator so later steps can find its portfolio. Firm as listed: {{firm_name}}. Domain hint (may be blank): {{firm_domain}}.

Find the firm's official website and confirm it is the investor itself, not a portfolio company, a fund-of-funds, a person, or a similarly named company. Do not conflate the firm with one of its funds, a partner at the firm, or a separate program (e.g. Accel vs Accel-KKR, Sequoia Capital vs Peak XV / HongShan, Techstars vs one Techstars city program). If two firms share the name, pick the one that is a VC or accelerator matching the hint, and say so in notes.

Return:
- official_name, firm_domain (bare, e.g. accel.com), firm_type (VC fund or Accelerator).
- aliases: other names the firm is written as in funding announcements and CRM data (short names, former names, regional arms that are the same firm), separated by " | ". Never include a different firm (Accel-KKR is not Accel). Include names that are ambiguous only if they're commonly used, and list risky ones in alias_collisions instead.
- alias_collisions: other organizations whose names contain or resemble this firm's name and must NOT be matched (e.g. for Accel: Accel-KKR | Accelerator | Accelerate). Separate with " | ".
- crunchbase_url: the firm's Crunchbase organization page (https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/...). Blank if not certain.
- linkedin_url: the firm's LinkedIn company page. Blank if not certain.
- x_url: the firm's official X account. Blank if not certain.
- news_urls: every official page on the firm's own website(s) where it announces investments, new portfolio companies or cohorts (news, blog, press, portfolio news, cohort or batch pages, demo day pages). Separate with " | ". Open each to confirm it lists dated posts or companies. Only the firm's own domains.
- feed_url: an RSS or Atom feed for those announcements if one exists, else blank.
- portfolio_url: the firm's official portfolio or company directory page, if any.
- identity_confidence: High when the website, LinkedIn and Crunchbase agree; Medium when one is missing; Low when unclear.
- notes: one or two sentences on anything ambiguous.
Leave a field blank rather than guess.

import json, re
from datetime import date, timedelta

def _split(s):
    return [x.strip() for x in (s or '').split('|') if x.strip()]

def _sql_str(s):
    return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"

def handler(context):
    raw = context.get_input
    cached = raw('cached_identity') or {}
    fresh = bool(raw('identity_fresh'))
    def g(k):
        # Fresh research (when it ran) wins; otherwise the identity saved by an earlier run.
        v = raw(k)
        if (v is None or v == '') and k in cached: return cached.get(k)
        return v
    name = (g('official_name') or g('firm_name') or '').strip()
    listed = (g('firm_name') or '').strip()
    domain = (g('firm_domain') or g('firm_domain_hint') or '').strip().lower()
    domain = re.sub(r'^https?://', '', domain); domain = re.sub(r'^www\.', '', domain).split('/')[0]
    months = int(g('lookback_months') or 12)
    since = (date.today() - timedelta(days=round(months * 30.44))).isoformat()
    aliases = []
    for a in [name, listed] + _split(g('aliases')):
        if a and a.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in aliases]:
            aliases.append(a)
    collisions = _split(g('alias_collisions'))
    cb = (g('crunchbase_url') or '').strip()
    cb = cb if re.match(r'^https://www\.crunchbase\.com/organization/[a-z0-9-]+/?$', cb) else ''
    li = (g('linkedin_url') or '').strip()
    li = li if re.match(r'^https://(www\.)?linkedin\.com/company/[^/?#]+/?$', li) else ''
    quoted = '"' + name + '"'
    google = [
        f'{quoted} led seed round {date.today().year}',
        f'{quoted} leads Series A',
        f'{quoted} backed startup raises',
        f'{quoted} invests in',
        f'{quoted} portfolio company announces funding',
    ]
    if (g('firm_type') or '').lower().startswith('accel'):
        google += [f'{quoted} new cohort startups', f'{quoted} demo day companies', f'{quoted} batch announced']
    # Salesforce reverse lookup: whole-word alias match on the investor-names field.
    # Confusable names (e.g. Accel-KKR) are blanked out of the text first, so a row naming both still matches.
    # Snowflake: REGEXP_LIKE is anchored to the whole string, so use REGEXP_INSTR > 0; and backslashes are
    # string escapes, so special characters are bracketed ([.]) instead of backslash-escaped.
    def lit(a):
        out = ''
        for ch in a.lower():
            out += ch if (ch.isalnum() or ch == ' ') else ('[' + ch + ']' if ch not in '^]\\' else '')
        return out
    x = "LOWER(a.FUNDING_INVESTOR_NAMES_C)"
    for c in collisions:
        x = f"REGEXP_REPLACE({x}, {_sql_str(lit(c))}, ' ')"
    likes = ' OR '.join(f"REGEXP_INSTR({x}, {_sql_str('(^|[^a-z0-9])' + lit(a) + '($|[^a-z0-9])')}) > 0" for a in aliases) or 'FALSE'
    sf = f"""WITH hits AS (
  SELECT a.ID, a.NAME, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.DOMAIN_C, ''), a.WEBSITE, ''), '^https?://', ''), '^www[.]', '')) AS DOMAIN,
         a.FUNDING_INVESTOR_NAMES_C AS INVESTORS, TO_VARCHAR(a.LAST_FUNDING_DATE_C::DATE) AS LAST_FUNDING_DATE, a.LAST_FUNDING_TYPE_C AS LAST_FUNDING_TYPE,
         a.LAST_FUNDING_AMOUNT_C AS LAST_FUNDING_AMOUNT, a.FUNDING_SOURCE_LINK_C AS SOURCE_LINK, a.FUNDING_SOURCE_C AS SOURCE,
         a.COMPANY_SEGMENT_C AS SEGMENT, TO_VARCHAR(a.CREATED_DATE::DATE) AS SF_CREATED
  FROM FIVETRAN.SALESFORCE.ACCOUNT a
  WHERE a.IS_DELETED = FALSE AND a.FUNDING_INVESTOR_NAMES_C IS NOT NULL AND ({likes}))
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_MATCHES, * FROM hits ORDER BY LAST_FUNDING_DATE DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1500"""
    news_urls = (raw('news_urls') or '') if not fresh else (raw('cached_news_urls') or raw('news_urls') or '')
    return {
        'firm': name, 'firm_listed': listed, 'firm_domain': domain, 'since': since, 'lookback_months': months,
        'news_since': raw('news_since') or since, 'news_urls': news_urls, 'portfolio_url': g('portfolio_url') or '',
        'identity_refreshed': not fresh, 'official_name': name, 'firm_type': g('firm_type') or '', 'x_url': g('x_url') or '',
        'aliases_text': ' | '.join(aliases), 'collisions_text': ' | '.join(collisions), 'crunchbase_url': cb, 'linkedin_url': li,
        'identity_confidence': g('identity_confidence') or '',
        'aliases': aliases, 'collisions': collisions,
        'crunchbase_urls': [cb] if cb else [],
        'dealroom_domains': [domain] if domain else [],
        'pitchbook_queries': [domain] if domain else [],
        'linkedin_urls': [li] if li else [],
        'google_queries': google,
        'sf_query': sf,
        'max_verify': int(g('max_verify') or 300),
    }

currentScriptVersion.code:
import math

def _items(x):
    if isinstance(x, list): return x
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k in ('results', 'entries', 'items', 'outputs'):
            if isinstance(x.get(k), list): return x[k]
        return [x]
    return []

def handler(context):
    first = _items(context.get_input('page1'))
    domains = context.get_input('domains') or []
    pages, total, page_size, seen = [], 0, 100, 0
    for i, it in enumerate(first):
        r = (it.get('result', it) if isinstance(it, dict) else None)
        if not isinstance(r, dict): continue
        total = int(r.get('total') or 0)
        seen = len(r.get('data') or [])
        page_size = max(seen, 1) if total > seen else 100
        dom = domains[i] if i < len(domains) else ''
        last = min(math.ceil(total / 100), 30)          # hard cap: 30 pages = 3,000 companies
        pages += [{'domain': dom, 'page': p} for p in range(2, last + 1)]
    capped = total > 3000
    return {'dealroom_pages': pages, 'dealroom_total': total, 'dealroom_capped': capped}

claygentSnapshot.userPrompt:
Work out how to read the official portfolio of {{firm}} ({{firm_domain}}) reliably with a plain web scraper, so a weekly job can replay it without research. Known portfolio page (may be outdated or blank): {{portfolio_url}}. Other official pages: {{news_urls}}.

Check, in this order, and use the first that works:
1. sitemap: fetch https://{{firm_domain}}/robots.txt for "Sitemap:" lines, then /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml. If a sitemap lists one URL per portfolio company (e.g. /companies/<slug>, /portfolio/<slug>), use it. link_pattern = a regex matching those company URLs only (not /companies alone, not team or news pages).
2. feed: an RSS/Atom feed that lists portfolio companies (rare).
3. static_html: the portfolio page lists companies in its raw HTML (visible without JavaScript). link_pattern = "external" if each company links to its own website, or a regex for the firm's own company profile URLs.
4. js_html: the page only shows companies after JavaScript runs. Same link_pattern rules; needs_js = true.
5. profile_pages: the directory itself can't be listed but each company has a readable profile page on the firm's site; profile_pattern = regex for those URLs; list_url = the page or sitemap that links to them, if any.
6. agent_only: none of the above works.

The portfolio page may have moved: if the known page is gone or empty, find the current one from the site's navigation or a site search.
Count how many companies your recipe finds and, if the site states a total, record it as expected_count. Prefer the option that returns the most complete list.
Return method, list_url (exactly what to fetch), needs_js, link_pattern, profile_pattern, expected_count (0 if not stated), companies_found, portfolio_url (the current page), and recipe_notes (one or two sentences: what you checked and why this recipe).

claygentSnapshot.userPrompt:
List the portfolio of {{firm}} ({{firm_domain}}) from the firm's own website. Portfolio or company directory page: {{portfolio_url}}. Other official pages that may list companies or cohorts: {{news_urls}}.

Read every company the firm lists as a portfolio company or cohort member, across all pages, tabs, filters (funds, sectors, years, batches) and "load more". Include current and past companies; mark status when shown (active, exited, acquired, IPO, closed). Dates are not required here: this is the full roster, not recent news.

For each company give: company, website (the company's own site, as linked from the directory; blank if not linked), fund_or_batch (e.g. Fund II, W25, Spring 2026; blank if not shown), status, profile_url (the firm's page for that company, if any).

If the directory has more than 400 companies, return the 400 most recent you can identify (newest fund or batch first), set portfolio_page_status to "Truncated", and say in portfolio_coverage how many exist and which part you covered. Never invent companies.

Always return a result, even when the directory is incomplete, hidden behind scripts, or missing: return the companies you could read, set portfolio_page_status to "Partial" (or "No directory found" / "Fetch failed"), and explain exactly what was and wasn't readable in portfolio_coverage. Other steps cover the rest of the portfolio, so a partial list is useful; failing is not.

Return portfolio_json as a JSON array (no prose) of those objects.

claygentSnapshot.userPrompt:
You collect announcements of investments and cohort admissions for one investor, from its own website first and then news and social sources. Firm: {{firm}} ({{firm_domain}}). Other names it uses: {{aliases}}. Do NOT treat these as the same firm: {{collisions}}. Window: announcements on or after {{since}}.

1. Official pages (required). Read each of these on the firm's own site: {{news_urls}}. Feed, if any: {{feed_url}}. Portfolio directory, if any: {{portfolio_url}}. Start with the newest posts and page backwards (next page, "load more", older posts, feed pages) until you pass {{since}} or the archive ends. For each post or listing in the window that announces the firm investing in a company, leading or joining a round, or admitting a company to a cohort or batch, open the post and record it. Skip fund closes, hires, events, thought pieces, podcasts, exits, IPOs and acquisitions. Record how far back you actually got.
2. Google leads: these search results were gathered earlier; open the promising ones and record only what the article itself says: {{google_results}}
3. LinkedIn: if the firm has a LinkedIn page, check its recent posts for investment or cohort announcements, if you can access them.
4. X: if the firm has an X account ({{x_url}}), check its recent posts for the same, if you can access them.

Rules: one entry per company per event. Use the company's own website domain when the source gives it or you can confirm it quickly; otherwise leave it blank. Never invent a company, date, amount or round type; leave unknown fields blank. Joining a cohort is event_type "cohort", not a funding round, unless the post states a completed raise.

Return announcements_json: a JSON array (no prose) of objects with keys company, company_domain, event_type ("funding_round" | "cohort" | "investment"), round_type (e.g. Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A; blank if not stated), announced_on (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM, blank if unknown), amount_usd (number or blank), firm_role ("lead" | "participant" | "cohort" | "unknown"), source_lane ("official_page" | "google" | "linkedin" | "x"), source_url. Also return archive_status and archive_coverage.

Always return a result: if pages can't be read or nothing qualifies, return [] with archive_status set accordingly and explain in archive_coverage. Never fail the step.

Also return news_sources_json: a JSON array with one object per official page you were given or found, with keys url, source_type ("news" | "blog" | "press" | "portfolio_news" | "cohort" | "feed"), status ("ok" if you could read its dated posts, "failed" if it was missing, moved, empty or blocked), newest_date (YYYY-MM-DD of the newest post you saw, blank if none) and newest_url. If a page has moved, include the new location as its own entry with status "ok".

import re

def _items(x):
    if isinstance(x, list): return x
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k in ('results', 'entries', 'items', 'outputs'):
            if isinstance(x.get(k), list): return x[k]
        return [x]
    return []

def dom(u):
    u = (u or '').strip().lower()
    u = re.sub(r'^[a-z]+://', '', u); u = re.sub(r'^www\d?\.', '', u)
    u = u.split('/')[0].strip('.')
    return u if re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,63}', u) and '..' not in u else ''

def handler(context):
    tv = context.get_input('to_verify') or []
    held = context.get_input('held') or []
    ver = _items(context.get_input('verified'))
    doms = []
    for i, c in enumerate(tv):
        v = ver[i] if i < len(ver) else {}
        v = v.get('output', v) if isinstance(v, dict) else {}
        d = dom((v or {}).get('company_domain')) or dom(c.get('domain'))
        if d: doms.append(d)
    doms += [dom(c.get('domain')) for c in held if dom(c.get('domain'))]
    doms += [dom(x) for x in (context.get_input('held_domains') or []) if dom(x)]
    doms += [dom(c.get('domain')) for c in (context.get_input('cached') or []) if dom(c.get('domain'))]
    doms = sorted(set(doms))[:4000]
    if not doms:
        return {'query': "SELECT NULL AS DOMAIN, '[]' AS WS_JSON, '[]' AS SF_JSON WHERE FALSE", 'domains': [], 'domain_count': 0}
    vals = ', '.join("('" + d + "')" for d in doms)
    q = f"""WITH roster AS (SELECT COLUMN1 AS DOMAIN FROM VALUES {vals}),
m AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.DOMAIN, TO_VARCHAR(w.WORKSPACE_ID) AS WORKSPACE_ID, 'creator_domain' AS METHOD
  FROM roster r JOIN DBT.PROD.IDENTITY_RESOLUTION_WORKSPACE_BASE w
    ON REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(w.WORKSPACE_CREATED_BY_USER_DOMAIN)), '^www[.]', '') = r.DOMAIN WHERE w.WORKSPACE_ID IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT r.DOMAIN, TO_VARCHAR(w.WORKSPACE_ID), 'attribution_domain'
  FROM roster r JOIN DBT.PROD.FCT_PLG_WORKSPACE_ATTRIBUTION_MAP w
    ON REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(w.CUSTOMER_DOMAIN)), '^www[.]', '') = r.DOMAIN WHERE w.WORKSPACE_ID IS NOT NULL),
p AS (
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(WORKSPACE_ID) AS WORKSPACE_ID, MAX(IFF(FIRST_INVOICE_UTC IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS EVER_PAID,
         MAX(IFF(BINARY_CURRENT_CUSTOMER = 1, 1, 0)) AS PAYING_NOW, TO_VARCHAR(MIN(CREATED_AT_UTC)::DATE) AS WS_CREATED,
         TO_VARCHAR(MIN(FIRST_INVOICE_UTC)::DATE) AS FIRST_PAID
  FROM DBT.PROD.CUSTOMERS WHERE TO_VARCHAR(WORKSPACE_ID) IN (SELECT WORKSPACE_ID FROM m) GROUP BY 1),
shared AS (SELECT WORKSPACE_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT DOMAIN) AS N_DOMAINS FROM m GROUP BY 1),
wsj AS (
  SELECT m.DOMAIN, ARRAY_AGG(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('workspace_id', m.WORKSPACE_ID, 'method', m.METHOD, 'ever_paid', p.EVER_PAID,
         'paying_now', p.PAYING_NOW, 'created', p.WS_CREATED, 'first_paid', p.FIRST_PAID, 'shared_domains', s.N_DOMAINS)) AS WS
  FROM m LEFT JOIN p USING (WORKSPACE_ID) LEFT JOIN shared s USING (WORKSPACE_ID) GROUP BY m.DOMAIN),
sf AS (
  SELECT LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(a.DOMAIN_C, '^https?://', ''), '^www[.]', '')) AS DOMAIN,
         ARRAY_AGG(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('account_id', a.ID, 'owner_id', a.OWNER_ID, 'sales_tier', a.SALES_TIER_C, 'open_pipeline', a.OPEN_PIPELINE_C,
                   'account_stage', a.ACCOUNT_STAGE_C, 'gtme', a.GTME_C, 'segment', a.COMPANY_SEGMENT_C)) AS SF
  FROM FIVETRAN.SALESFORCE.ACCOUNT a
  WHERE a.IS_DELETED = FALSE AND LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(a.DOMAIN_C, '^https?://', ''), '^www[.]', '')) IN (SELECT DOMAIN FROM roster)
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.DOMAIN, TO_JSON(COALESCE(wsj.WS, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())) AS WS_JSON, TO_JSON(COALESCE(sf.SF, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())) AS SF_JSON
FROM roster r LEFT JOIN wsj USING (DOMAIN) LEFT JOIN sf USING (DOMAIN) ORDER BY r.DOMAIN"""
    return {'query': q, 'domains': doms, 'domain_count': len(doms)}

import json, re

def _items(x):

    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k in ('results', 'entries', 'items', 'outputs'):
            if isinstance(x.get(k), list): return x[k]
        return [x]
    return []

def dom(u):
    u = (u or '').strip().lower()
    u = re.sub(r'^[a-z]+://', '', u); u = re.sub(r'^www\d?\.', '', u)
    u = u.split('/')[0].strip('.')
    return u if re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,63}', u) else ''

def tri(x):
    return 'unknown' if x is None else ('yes' if x else 'no')

LANES = ['official_page', 'official_portfolio', 'google', 'linkedin', 'x', 'dealroom', 'pitchbook', 'crunchbase', 'salesforce']

def handler(context):
    g = context.get_input
    firm = g('firm') or ''
    tv = g('to_verify') or []; held = g('held') or []
    ver = _items(g('verified'))
    snow = g('status') or {}
    snow = snow.get('result', snow) if isinstance(snow, dict) else {}
    lookup_ok = isinstance(snow, dict) and isinstance(snow.get('rows'), list)
    st = {}
    for r in (snow.get('rows') or []) if lookup_ok else []:
        try: ws = json.loads(r.get('WS_JSON') or '[]'); sf = json.loads(r.get('SF_JSON') or '[]')
        except (ValueError, TypeError): ws, sf = None, []
        st[r.get('DOMAIN')] = (ws, sf)

    def clay_status(d):
        if not d: return 'unknown: no domain', 0, None, None, []
        if not lookup_ok or d not in st: return 'unknown: lookup failed', 0, None, None, []
        ws, sf = st[d]
        if ws is None: return 'unknown: lookup failed', 0, None, None, sf
        ids = {w.get('workspace_id') for w in ws if w.get('workspace_id')}
        if any((w.get('shared_domains') or 1) > 1 for w in ws): return 'needs review: workspace shared across domains', len(ids), None, None, sf
        if not ids: return 'not on Clay (no exact domain match)', 0, False, False, sf
        paying = any(w.get('paying_now') == 1 for w in ws); ever = any(w.get('ever_paid') == 1 for w in ws)
        return ('paying' if paying else 'paid before, not now' if ever else 'free workspace'), len(ids), ever, paying, sf

    rows, review = [], []
    for i, c in enumerate(tv):
        v = ver[i] if i < len(ver) else {}
        v = v.get('output', v) if isinstance(v, dict) else {}
        v = v or {}
        d = dom(v.get('company_domain')) or dom(c.get('domain'))
        status, nws, ever, paying, sf = clay_status(d)
        backing = v.get('backing') or 'Not checked (verification failed)'
        open_pipe = any((a.get('open_pipeline') or 0) > 0 for a in sf)
        confirmed = backing == 'Confirmed'
        target = confirmed and status.startswith('not on Clay') and not open_pipe
        recent = (v.get('round_in_window') == 'Yes')
        row = {'firm': firm, 'company': v.get('company_name') or c.get('name') or '', 'domain': d, 'found_by': c.get('lanes') or [],
               'backing': backing, 'relationship': v.get('relationship') or '', 'backing_source_url': v.get('backing_source_url') or '',
               'in_portfolio_denominator': confirmed, 'is_stealth': bool(v.get('is_stealth')),
               'latest_round_type': v.get('latest_round_type') or '', 'latest_round_date': v.get('latest_round_date') or '',
               'latest_round_amount_usd': float(v.get('latest_round_amount_usd') or 0), 'latest_round_leads': v.get('latest_round_leads') or '',
               'latest_round_source_url': v.get('latest_round_source_url') or '', 'firm_in_latest_round': v.get('firm_in_latest_round') or 'Unknown',
               'funded_in_window': v.get('round_in_window') or 'Unknown',
               'clay_status': status, 'workspaces': nws, 'ever_paid': tri(ever), 'paying_now': tri(paying),
               'salesforce_accounts': [str(a.get('account_id')) for a in sf if a.get('account_id')], 'sales_tier': next((str(a.get('sales_tier')) for a in sf if a.get('sales_tier')), ''),
               'open_pipeline': open_pipe, 'target': target, 'recently_funded_target': target and recent,
               'notes': v.get('notes') or ''}
        rows.append(row)
        if backing in ('Unclear', 'Not checked (verification failed)') or status.startswith('needs review'):
            review.append({'company': row['company'], 'domain': d, 'why': backing if not status.startswith('needs review') else status})
    # Companies carried forward from earlier verification (no new signal this week): same row shape, Clay status refreshed.
    for c in g('cached') or []:
        d = dom(c.get('domain'))
        status, nws, ever, paying, sf = clay_status(d)
        backing = c.get('backing') or 'Unclear'
        open_pipe = any((a.get('open_pipeline') or 0) > 0 for a in sf)
        confirmed = backing == 'Confirmed'
        target = confirmed and status.startswith('not on Clay') and not open_pipe
        def inwin(x):
            x = (x or '')[:10]
            return 'Yes' if x and x >= (g('since') or '') else ('No' if x else 'Unknown')
        rows.append({'firm': firm, 'company': c.get('name') or '', 'domain': d, 'found_by': c.get('lanes') or [],
                     'backing': backing, 'relationship': c.get('relationship') or '', 'backing_source_url': c.get('backing_source_url') or '',
                     'in_portfolio_denominator': confirmed, 'is_stealth': False,
                     'latest_round_type': c.get('latest_round_type') or '', 'latest_round_date': c.get('latest_round_date') or '',
                     'latest_round_amount_usd': float(c.get('latest_round_amount_usd') or 0), 'latest_round_leads': c.get('latest_round_leads') or '',
                     'latest_round_source_url': c.get('latest_round_source_url') or '', 'firm_in_latest_round': c.get('firm_in_latest_round') or 'Unknown',
                     'funded_in_window': inwin(c.get('latest_round_date')),
                     'clay_status': status, 'workspaces': nws, 'ever_paid': tri(ever), 'paying_now': tri(paying),
                     'salesforce_accounts': [str(a.get('account_id')) for a in sf if a.get('account_id')],
                     'sales_tier': next((str(a.get('sales_tier')) for a in sf if a.get('sales_tier')), ''),
                     'open_pipeline': open_pipe, 'target': target, 'recently_funded_target': target and inwin(c.get('latest_round_date')) == 'Yes',
                     'notes': 'Carried forward: verified ' + (c.get('verified_at') or '')[:10]})
    # Merge rows that verification resolved to the same company domain (e.g. a PitchBook name with no website).
    order = {'Confirmed': 0, 'Unclear': 1, 'Not confirmed': 2, 'Different firm': 3}
    merged, by_d = [], {}
    for r in rows:
        k = r['domain'] or ''
        if k and k in by_d:
            m = by_d[k]
            m['found_by'] = sorted(set(m['found_by']) | set(r['found_by']))
            if order.get(r['backing'], 9) < order.get(m['backing'], 9):
                for f in ('backing', 'relationship', 'backing_source_url', 'in_portfolio_denominator'): m[f] = r[f]
            if (r['latest_round_date'] or '') > (m['latest_round_date'] or ''):
                for f in ('latest_round_type', 'latest_round_date', 'latest_round_amount_usd', 'latest_round_leads', 'latest_round_source_url', 'firm_in_latest_round', 'funded_in_window'): m[f] = r[f]
            m['target'] = m['in_portfolio_denominator'] and m['clay_status'].startswith('not on Clay') and not m['open_pipeline']
            m['recently_funded_target'] = m['target'] and m['funded_in_window'] == 'Yes'
            continue
        if k: by_d[k] = r
        merged.append(r)
    rows = merged
    review = [x for x in review if not x['domain'] or by_d.get(x['domain']) is None or not by_d[x['domain']]['in_portfolio_denominator']]
    unverified = []
    for c in held:
        d = dom(c.get('domain')); status, nws, ever, paying, sf = clay_status(d)
        unverified.append({'firm': firm, 'company': c.get('name') or '', 'domain': d, 'found_by': c.get('lanes') or [], 'latest_hint': c.get('latest_hint') or '',
                           'clay_status': status, 'workspaces': nws})

    conf = [r for r in rows if r['in_portfolio_denominator']]
    lanes = sorted({l for r in rows for l in (r['found_by'] or [])})
    summary = {
        'firm': firm, 'identity_confidence': g('identity_confidence') or '', 'window_start': g('since') or '',
        'candidates': len(tv) + len(held) + len(g('cached') or []), 'verified_this_run': len(tv), 'not_verified_this_run': int(g('held_count') or len(held)), 'carried_forward': len(g('cached') or []),
        'backing': {'confirmed': sum(r['backing'] == 'Confirmed' for r in rows), 'not_confirmed': sum(r['backing'] == 'Not confirmed' for r in rows),
                    'different_firm': sum(r['backing'] == 'Different firm' for r in rows), 'unclear': sum(r['backing'] == 'Unclear' for r in rows),
                    'not_checked': sum(r['backing'].startswith('Not checked') for r in rows)},
        'portfolio_confirmed': len(conf),
        'with_workspace': sum(1 for r in conf if r['workspaces'] > 0 and not r['clay_status'].startswith(('unknown', 'needs'))),
        'paying_now': sum(1 for r in conf if r['paying_now'] == 'yes'), 'ever_paid': sum(1 for r in conf if r['ever_paid'] == 'yes'),
        'clay_status_unknown': sum(1 for r in conf if r['clay_status'].startswith(('unknown', 'needs'))),
        'targets': sum(1 for r in conf if r['target']), 'recently_funded_targets': sum(1 for r in conf if r['recently_funded_target']),
        'funded_in_window': sum(1 for r in conf if r['funded_in_window'] == 'Yes'),
        'confirmed_by_lane': {l: sum(1 for r in conf if l in r['found_by']) for l in LANES},
        'confirmed_only_this_lane': {l: sum(1 for r in conf if r['found_by'] == [l]) for l in LANES},
        'candidates_by_lane': {l: int((g('lane_counts') or {}).get(l) or 0) for l in LANES},
        'caps': {'salesforce_capped': bool((g('caps') or {}).get('salesforce_capped')), 'salesforce_total_matches': int((g('caps') or {}).get('salesforce_total_matches') or 0),
                 'dealroom_capped': bool((g('caps') or {}).get('dealroom_capped')), 'dealroom_total': int((g('caps') or {}).get('dealroom_total') or 0)},
        'portfolio_page_status': g('portfolio_page_status') or '',
        'archive_status': g('archive_status') or '', 'archive_coverage': g('archive_coverage') or '',
        'status_lookup_ok': lookup_ok, 'review_count': len(review),
    }
    return {'summary': summary, 'portfolio': rows, 'not_verified': unverified, 'review': review}

body.title: Body
body.description:
Enter the data body to include, e.g:  
```json
{
	"email": "sam@clay.com",
	"age": 1,
	"is_active": true
}
```
It follows the rules of JSON bodies, so booleans/numbers will not be surrounded by quotes, but strings will.

method.title: Method
method.description:
Enter the HTTP method of your call:  
• GET – Get data  
• POST – Send data  
• PATCH – Update data with only the fields you specify  
• PUT – Update data entirely  
• DELETE – Remove data  
• HEAD – To check if the endpoint is reachable  
• OPTIONS – Get the supported HTTP methods  
• QUERY – Query data using a request body

headers.title: Headers
headers.description:
Enter request headers as JSON, e.g:  
`{"Content-Type": "application/json"}`  
💡 **Tip:** Store credentials like `X-API-Key` or `Authorization` in an HTTP API (Headers) account for added security and so you can reuse them.

fieldPaths.title: Response values to return
fieldPaths.description: Want to keep just specific parts of the API response? Enter the fields you need here—for example: email, name, or contact.email.status. Use dots to access nested data. Leave this blank to keep everything.

removeNull.title: Remove empty values
removeNull.description: Toggle this field if you want to remove any values that are empty, null, or undefined from the request. This is useful when you want to avoid sending empty values to an API so no data is overwritten for blank fields.

queryString.title: Query parameters
queryString.description: Enter any query parameters to set when making the API Request i.e. email -> eric@clay.com

shouldRetry.title: Retry on failure
shouldRetry.description: Toggle this field if you want to retry the request if it fails. Defaults to true.

followRedirects.title: Follow redirects
followRedirects.description: Toggle this field if you want to follow HTTP 3xx responses (e.g. 301, 302, 303, 307, 308). This is useful if you want to follow redirects to the final URL. Defaults to true.

responseTimeout.title: Response timeout (ms)
responseTimeout.description: Override the default maximum wait time for a response from the API in milliseconds. Minimum is 1000ms and maximum is 100000ms.

returnResponseMetadata.title: Return response metadata
returnResponseMetadata.description: Toggle this field if you want to return additional information from the API call, including the status code and headers.
